part_number.product: SEL-TWFL Dual Traveling-Wave Fault Locator and 12-Channel MHz Recorder

prefix.description: SEL-TWFL Dual Traveling-Wave Fault Locator (fixed 'TWFL#' literal, followed by a 4-digit catalog model code)

part_number.note: The SEL-TWFL is NOT a per-digit configurable Model Option Table. It is a fixed catalog: the model string is 'TWFL#' followed by a 4-digit code that selects one predefined combination of AC current-input rating, power-supply rating, and contact (digital) input voltage. Only the enumerated codes exist (0001-0012 and 0019). Confirmed against the IM CID block (PARTNO=TWFL#0001) and IM Table 1.2 'SEL-TWFL Models'. There are no drawing option-group layers to anchor against; calibration is entirely from the genuine catalog codes.
references: SEL-TWFL Instruction Manual (TWFL_IM_20240213), Table 1.2 'SEL-TWFL Models'; CID PARTNO=TWFL#0001

example_part_numbers.note: Genuine model from IM CID (PARTNO=TWFL#0001) and Table 1.2: 5 A current input, 125-250 Vdc / 110-240 Vac power supply, 125 Vdc contact inputs
